help-subtitle: Get additional information on how Seamless Access works.
help-a-cannot-find-institution-p1: If you cannot find your institution, it usually means that it is not available through this sign-in method.
help-a-cannot-find-institution-p2: Each publisher decides which institutions to show. Many publishers and service providers that integrate with SeamlessAccess use a list from a Research & Education (R&E) Federation.
help-a-cannot-find-institution-p3: Not every institution belongs to an R&E Federation. Publishers may also use different lists. Because of this, your institution may appear on one website but not on another.
help-a-cannot-find-institution-p4: If you cannot find your institution, try another sign-in option offered by the publisher or service provider that you’re trying to access.
help-q-cannot-access-after-login: I cannot access the article after logging in?
help-a-cannot-access-after-login-p1: SeamlessAccess helps you find your institution and takes you to its sign-in page. It does not decide whether you can access an article or other content.
help-a-cannot-access-after-login-p2: Your access depends on your institution’s agreement or subscription with the publisher or service provider.
help-a-cannot-access-after-login-p3: If you can sign in but still cannot open the content, your institution may not have access to it.
help-a-suggested-institutions-p1: Some publishers choose to show a short list of suggested institutions to make sign-in faster.
help-a-suggested-institutions-p2: These suggestions are usually the institutions that visitors use most often.
help-a-suggested-institutions-p3: The suggested list does not include every available institution. If you do not see your institution, use the search box to find it.
help-q-added-by-site-generic: Why are institutions added by this site?
help-a-added-by-site-p1: The site you're visiting has added extra institutions so that more users can sign in and access content.
help-a-added-by-site-p2: These institutions are shown separately from institutions provided through Research & Education (R&E) Federations.
help-a-added-by-site-p3: R&E Federations have privacy and security rules for the institutions that belong to them. The institutions added by $1 may follow different security and privacy rules. To learn more about this, please review the policies on $1.
help-a-added-by-site-p3-generic: R&E Federations have privacy and security rules for the institutions that belong to them. The institutions added by this site may follow different security and privacy rules. To learn more about this, please review the policies on the site.
help-q-remember-me: What does it mean to “Remember me”?
help-a-remember-me-p1: If you select Remember me, SeamlessAccess remembers your institution in your browser (see our
help-a-remember-me-p1-after: for more information about how information is stored).
help-a-remember-me-p2: The next time you visit the site, your institution may already be selected for you. This means that you won’t need to search for it again, saving time and effort.
help-a-remember-me-p3: On many websites that use SeamlessAccess, your remembered institution can also be used to make signing in easier.
help-q-not-remembered-across-sites: Why is my institution not being remembered across sites?
help-a-not-remembered-across-sites-p1: Your institution is not always remembered on every website.
help-a-not-remembered-across-sites-p2: Some publishers and service providers do not use SeamlessAccess. Others use SeamlessAccess but do not support the Remember me feature.
help-a-not-remembered-across-sites-p3: Because of this, your institution may be remembered on some websites but not on others.
